Integration._comment: Set FieldEncryptionKey and BlindIndexKey per environment (base64, 32 bytes) through user-secrets or Integration__FieldEncryptionKey. They are validated on first use, not at boot, so a missing key surfaces as a failed command rather than a failed start-up.

Swagger._comment: Enabled is null here, which means Development only. Set Swagger__Enabled=true to publish the Swagger UI and the OpenAPI document on another host; they are then served ONLY behind HTTP Basic auth, and answer 503 until Swagger__Auth__Password is set. Never put the password in this file.

_ApiKey: Service key guarding POST /api/v1/users/create-root, the endpoint that provisions a super-user. EMPTY here ON PURPOSE: outside Development ApiKeyEndpointFilter answers 503 until it is configured, which is the fail-closed behaviour it exists for. It used to hold a literal key committed to the repository, and docker-compose did not override it - so the key guarding super-user provisioning on a deployment was readable by anyone with the repo. Set it from the environment: ApiKey__ (SANKORE_API_KEY in docker-compose).
